editorial_review.reviewer: OpenAI assistant under the author’s direction
editorial_review.scope: English translation and operational expansion of all 84 existing practice descriptors; the 12 families, navigation and provenance were reviewed. All cards have specific use conditions, steps, illustrative examples, checks and limits. No new empirical findings are claimed.
editorial_review.secondary_review: Independent review of 12 representative and critical cards, plus root review of 17 cards; clarified PAT027 alias and corrected PAT034 avoid-conditions. Also expanded the PAT021 budget alias for clarity.
